about: The day-file guard's words, one table for both apps (2026-10-16 review of the guard merge, items 1, 6 and 9). A refusal is "Couldn't <doing> — <page> won't read", the page named from the day that refused (Android CalendarDayService.refusal / iOS DayFileWords.couldnt). Android runs these in DayGuardWordsGoldenTest; iOS runs the same cases. Strings compare exactly.

synth.expected: ❖ Couldn't write back on Synthesize — the Jan 2, 2020 page won't read. The reply is kept; it lands once the page reads.
❖ Couldn't write back on Hip hinge · page 2 — the Jan 2, 2020 page won't read. The reply is kept; it lands once the page reads.
❖ Couldn't add the cited cards — the Jan 2, 2020 page won't read. They're kept and land once it does.
❖ Couldn't write back — the Jan 2, 2020 page won't read
